---
title: "Components"
sidebar: get-started
---

Choose a registered layout factory, then use its guide for default settings,
ports, and layer roles. Geometry dimensions use micrometres.

| Family | Component guides |
| --- | --- |
| CPW paths and resonators | [straight](straight.qmd), [taper](taper.qmd), [resonator](resonator.qmd), [resonator_hanger](resonator_hanger.qmd), [resonator_meander](resonator_meander.qmd) |
| Capacitors | [interdigital_capacitor](interdigital_capacitor.qmd), [martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor](martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor.qmd) |
| Launch and junction | [launcher](launcher.qmd), [cpw_t_junction](cpw_t_junction.qmd) |
| Connections and primitives | [airbridge](airbridge.qmd), [indium_bump](indium_bump.qmd), [indium_ground](indium_ground.qmd), [cpw_handoff](cpw_handoff.qmd), [rounded_end_metal_segment](rounded_end_metal_segment.qmd), [rounded_rectangle](rounded_rectangle.qmd), [wire_corner](wire_corner.qmd) |

For path widths, gaps, and section layers, see [Cross-sections](../cross-sections.qmd).
For placement, connection, routing, and export, use the [GDSFactory guide](../component-authoring.md).
